title: Embertrail
description: A lightweight and optimized modpack focused on exploration, adventure, and immersion, featuring new structures, an improved map, world expansions, and full Fabric support.
body:
✔️ A pack designed for adventure and world exploration
✔️ A world map with waypoints and full location tracking (JourneyMap, Waystones)
✔️ Hundreds of new structures, ruins, and points of interest (Structory, Explorify, Explorers Compass)
✔️ New cities, villages, and settlement systems (Villagernames, Towns and Towers, SuperMartijn Mods)
✔️ Improved configuration and mod compatibility (Cloth Config, Balm, Architectural, Collective)
✔️ New equipment and character upgrade systems (Trinkets, Puffish Skills, Simple Magnets)
✔️ Improved cave and dungeon formations (Formations, Overworld Formations)
✔️ Additional items, minerals, and gameplay systems (Artifacts, Supplementaries)
✔️ Improved immersion and game atmosphere (Moonlight, Cristellib, MVS)
✔️ Optimized, stable, and efficient base for Fabric mods
✔️ Ready for your own adventures, RPGs, and narrative worlds
